title: Synchronous EEG and fMRI dataset on inner speech
description: This dataset contains simultaneous EEG and fMRI recordings from participants performing an inner speech task, in which eight words were presented in random order and repeated across trials. Data were acquired with a 3T MRI scanner and a 64-channel BrainProducts EEG system in three subjects across two sessions each. EEG data include pulse artifact removal and are organized in BIDS format.
methods_description: Simultaneous EEG-fMRI was acquired using a 3T MRI scanner and a 64-channel BrainProducts EEG system (5000 Hz sampling), with fMRI TR of 2 s. Each trial comprised a 2 s fixation, 2 s word stimulus display, and 12 s rest; 8 words were each repeated 40 times in random order. Pulse artifacts were removed with BrainVision Analyzer.
